visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a black Chanel mesh handbag resting on a tan leather seat. A hand with manicured white nails reaches in to touch the gold interlocked CC logo. The lighting is bright and indoor, highlighting the texture of the mesh and the metallic chain. (2) The view shifts to a black quilted leather backpack with mesh accents. A hand adjusts the bag to show the gold hardware. The background remains the same neutral-toned tan surface. (3) A white mesh crescent-shaped bag is presented. The camera captures a hand removing a small white quilted leather wallet from the interior. The background features a wooden table and blurred retail surroundings. (4) A full-shot mirror selfie shows a young woman wearing a white oversized t-shirt with a yellow race car graphic. She is holding the white mesh bag while wearing white socks and red athletic sneakers in a well-lit dressing room. (5) A black mesh baguette-style bag is showcased on a table. The camera focuses on the hand placing a small black leather card holder inside the bag. The background shows retail items and a marble-patterned surface. (6) The woman appears again in a mirror shot, modeling the black shoulder bag. The setting is a brightly lit clothing store with mirrors and shelving visible in the background. (7) A close-up view shows the black leather backpack being rotated by hand. The craftsmanship of the quilting and the mesh panels are clearly visible under bright studio-style lighting. (8) Final mirror shot features the woman wearing the black backpack over one shoulder, completing the product demonstration. She maintains a casual pose against the boutique background.
